english.title: Premises owner or occupier cause water fitting to be such that water supplied was likely to be contaminated
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner or occupier of premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) to which a supply of water was provided by a water

(A)_[undertaker,]_
(B)_[supply licensee,]_

intentionally or negligently caused or suffered a water fitting, namely **(..SPECIFY WATER FITTING..), for which you were responsible to be or remain so out of order, so in need of repair or so constructed or adapted, or to be so used that water that had been supplied by the

(C)_[undertaker]_
(D)_[licensee]_

to those premises was or was likely to be contaminated before it was used
english.legislation: Contrary to section 73(1)(b) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the owner or occupier of premises
to which a supply of water was provided by a water undertaker or licensed water supplier
intentionally or negligently caused or suffered a water fitting for which you were responsible
to be or remain so out of order, so in need of repair or so constructed or adapted, or to be so used
that water that had been supplied by the undertaker or supplier to those premises
was or was likely to be contaminated before it was used
